name: HFX stochastic (detail-weighted extra noise)
plain: After each deterministic step it adds fresh Gaussian noise scaled by the next sigma, a strength s and a per-pixel weight that is high where the latent has local detail (absolute high-pass divided by its mean). The noise is added on top of the step without lowering the target sigma, so the latent ends each step a little noisier than the schedule says. It draws with torch.randn_like, not the sampler's noise sampler. s is 0.08 for the base name and 0.03, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50 for _s1.._s4, with η fixed at 0.25.
math:
Shared hfx base (all ten families): a 2-stage exponential (res_2s-style) step with c2=0.65. Symbols: x latent; σ_i current sigma; σ_{i+1} next; h = ln(σ_i/σ_{i+1}); D(·,σ) model x0 prediction; φ1(h)=(1−e^{−h})/h, φ2(h)=(e^{−h}−1+h)/h²; N steps; i step index.
E1 = D(x,σ_i) − x; X2 = x + h·c2·φ1(c2h)·E1; E2 = D(X2, σ_i e^{−c2 h}) − x.
g_i = clip((i/(N−1) − 0.25)/0.30, 0, 1)   (ramp: off for the first quarter, full from 55%); η_i = η·g_i.
After the step: w = |x − box5(x)| / mean|x − box5(x)|; n ~ N(0, I);
x ← x + η_i · σ_{i+1} · s · n ⊙ w.
x ← x + h(b1 E1 + b2 E2'), b2 = φ2/c2, b1 = φ1 − b2. Last step (σ_{i+1} < 1e-6): x ← D(x,σ_i).

props.extra_model_calls: 1 per step (2 calls per step: res_2s-style base with c2=0.65)
